theory.tangent: For every null theta, l(theta)<=l(theta0)+g(theta0) dot (theta-theta0). The exact closed physical support upper bounds the last term.
theory.numerator: A product of normalized predictable predictive probabilities defines Q_n. For each true null theta, Q_n/L_theta,n is a nonnegative martingale (or supermartingale at zero-probability boundaries).
theory.denominator: exp(U_n)>=sup_null L_theta,n implies Q_n/exp(U_n)<=Q_n/L_true,n at every time.
theory.two_directions: If both directions share the SAME Q_n, every wrong-direction evidence is dominated by the SAME true-model likelihood-ratio process, so threshold 1/delta controls their union. Distinct direction-specific Q_n instead require an explicit allocation such as delta/2 each.
theory.count_aggregation: Denominator may aggregate identical queries; numerator must preserve the predictive probabilities used before each observation/block. No binomial coefficients in either ordered-outcome likelihood.
theory.limits: Numerical enclosure prototype, not formal proof-assistant verification; no SOTA or finite-cost claim.
